basis: Defined by congenital talonavicular dislocation and foot deformity; nonspecific neurological annotations do not establish direct neural damage in isolated CVT.
Meningeal tumour in the anterior cranial fossa; anatomical proximity to skull does not establish skeletal involvement.
Burning mouth syndrome is defined by oral burning pain; psychiatric associations do not add an axis, and neurological injury is not established here.
Retinal dystrophy, obesity/hypogonadism and polydactyly define BBS; renal anomalies are a major criterion despite insufficiency in 6/23. Neurological findings omitted under cap.
Hereditary TTR amyloid deposition with neuropathy; cardiac involvement occurs in roughly half, varying by variant; sensorineural hearing loss in 2/4 supplied cases.
Defining oral clefts and cardiac malformations; intellectual disability is supported by the explicit syndrome parent.
Hereditary cutaneous hypopigmentation; no extracutaneous disease is established.
Defined by brain malformations, developmental impairment and polydactyly; polymicrogyria in 12/12 and hand polydactyly in 11/12.
Defining gingival fibromatosis, nail hypoplasia and terminal phalangeal defects; intellectual disability in 30-79%. Hepatosplenomegaly occurs in only 5-29%.
Congenital neutropenia causes immunodeficiency; developmental delay in 3/8 and sensorineural hearing loss in 2/2 supplied cases, with limited hearing data.
Congenital muscular dystrophy with defining intellectual disability and brain malformations; retinal functional impairment documented by abnormal ERG in 1/1 case.
Non-allergic hypersensitivity can involve direct mast-cell or complement activation; no consistent organ damage is established across the umbrella.
Corticospinal tract degeneration defines disease; structural pes cavus and lower-limb amyotrophy occur in 30-79%. Urinary symptoms reflect neural dysfunction.
Diffuse inflammatory, generally immune-mediated injury of renal glomeruli resulting in renal failure.
Benign cutaneous melanocytic neoplasm with fibrous stroma.
Defined by skin/hair hypopigmentation and neurological impairment without immunodeficiency; retinopathy in 80-99%. Hyperlipidemia is a separately coded metabolic condition.
Defining lacrimal canal stenosis with dacryocystitis and skeletal osteopoikilosis; an infectious mechanism is not established for the syndrome itself.
Mature T/NK lymphoid-cell neoplasms, encompassing lymphomas and lymphoproliferative disorders; no single extranodal organ predominates across the group.
Cloacal exstrophy involves bladder and bowel; the accompanying frontonasal malformation defines a craniofacial structural abnormality.
Acquired transmissible prion infection causes central nervous system degeneration.
Skeletal myofibril degeneration defines the umbrella; cardiac involvement varies by subtype and is not established in >=30% overall. Respiratory muscle weakness remains muscular.
Tick ectoparasitic infestation produces a salivary neurotoxin causing neuromuscular paralysis.
Malignant neoplasm arising in the lacrimal apparatus, which belongs to the ocular axis.
Acute myeloid malignancy of marrow and blood defined by t(1;11); no common direct extranodal organ injury is established for this subtype.
Inherited valine catabolism disorder; developmental delay is reported without a frequency supporting >=30%. Vomiting and poor appetite do not establish gastrointestinal damage.
